description: A.410 shell with 5 tiny steel darts.  The spread makes it extremely accurate at short ranges.  An alternative to firing.45 FMJ from a carbine which is easier to score hits with but has more recoil.
A concussive.410 slug capable of quickly clearing through locks, doors or barriers by blunt force.  This load was not designed for use against moving targets and loses muzzle energy very quickly.
//: Shotgun loads designed specifically to break locks open exist, but implementing them would require source code changes and that ain't worth it. This is a more brute force alternative to such loads.
